intro: Browse small Motion wrappers that live under `@zentauri-ui/zentauri-components/animations/*`. They are separate from UI components so motion can be adopted one preset at a time.
useCases: Fade page sections and cards into view.
Add directional entrance motion to menus, panels, and list items.
Use scale, pop, slide, reveal, text, rotate, and blur transitions for overlays or featured content.
Keep animation imports separate from static component imports.

faqs.question: Do animations require Framer Motion?
faqs.answer: Yes. Install `framer-motion` before importing any `@zentauri-ui/zentauri-components/animations/*` entry.

faqs.question: Are these UI components?
faqs.answer: No. They are Motion wrappers and presets published under the separate `animations/*` category.

sections.heading: What it does
sections.body:
Provides small Motion wrappers for common entrance, slide, reveal, text, rotate, and exit transitions.

Each entry exports a component and its preset object.

sections.heading: Composition and API
sections.body: Wrap content with the animation component and pass regular Motion div props such as `transition`, `initial`, `animate`, `exit`, and `className`.

sections.heading: Next.js integration notes
sections.body: Use animation entries inside client components or client boundaries in the App Router.
